qa_suite_name: Campus Emergency Assistance QA Test Matrix

test_cases.title: Valid Student Roll-Number Login
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Response contains access_token and user object with role 'student'

test_cases.title: Invalid Password Authentication Rejection
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with detail message 'Invalid roll number or password'

test_cases.title: Campus Building & Room Verification Valid
test_cases.precondition: Engineering Block A and LAB-1 exist in master dataset
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Response indicates valid=true, floor=1, wing='West', room_type='Computer Lab'

test_cases.title: Unregistered Room Verification Rejection
test_cases.precondition: Room 999 does not exist in ENG-A
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Response indicates valid=false with descriptive message

test_cases.title: Critical Hazard Priority Engine Validation
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Alert created with priority='CRITICAL', status='NEW', and unique code ALT-...

test_cases.title: Duplicate Alert Debounce Cooldown (45s)
test_cases.precondition: Student 21CS001 has active NEW alert submitted 5s ago
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests informing that emergency response is already in progress

test_cases.title: Security Desk Acknowledge Alert
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Alert status transitions to 'ACKNOWLEDGED' and creates status history entry

test_cases.title: Tier 1 False Alarm Warning
test_cases.precondition: Alert submitted by student with 0 previous offenses

test_cases.title: Tier 3 False Alarm Higher Authority Referral
test_cases.precondition: Student with 2 previous false alerts commits 3rd offense

test_cases.title: Student Forbidden from Review Actions
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: HTTP 403 Forbidden with message 'Operation not permitted'
